Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
The rabbit visits the rabbit.

Green($x, bool) ::: Is x green?
Needs($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x need y?
Visits($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x visit y?
Sees($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x see y?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?

Rules:
Round($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: If something is round then it is rough.
Visits($x, Rabbit, True) && Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Visits(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: If something visits the rabbit and it needs the bald eagle then the rabbit visits the bald eagle.
Rough($x, True) >>> Visits($x, Lion, True) ::: If something is rough then it visits the lion.
Needs(Dog, Rabbit, True) && Sees(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) >>> Sees(BaldEagle, Dog, True) ::: If the dog needs the rabbit and the rabbit sees the bald eagle then the bald eagle sees the dog.
Visits(Rabbit, Lion, True) && Needs(Rabbit, Dog, True) >>> Round(Dog, True) ::: If the rabbit visits the lion and the rabbit needs the dog then the dog is round.
Visits($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: If something visits the rabbit then the rabbit needs the bald eagle.
Visits($x, Lion, True) && Needs(Lion, Dog, True) >>> Needs($x, Dog, True) ::: If something visits the lion and the lion needs the dog then it needs the dog.

Query:
Visits(Rabbit, Rabbit, True) ::: The rabbit visits the rabbit.
